AnswerIn.description: An answer to the pending question, which ``pack_id`` names.
AnswerIn.title: AnswerIn

AnswerLineOut.description: A question answered before the break: the moment's clock, the concept, right or not.
AnswerLineOut.title: AnswerLineOut

Band.description: A viewer's level on a concept, as the page keys its scenes and icons.
Band.title: Band

Bar.description:
One concept's mastery, from 0 to 1, with the level word ("Solid") and band for it.

The band is the level as a key the page switches on; "Mastered" is the Sharp band.
Bar.title: Bar

BeforeMatchOut.description:
What the page runs before the viewer's next match: First looks, then Level-ups.

``first_looks`` are the active concepts the viewer hasn't been introduced to; ``level_ups``
the concepts whose band rose over their last match; ``levels`` a row per active concept;
``unlock_note`` what the team sheet newly shows, if their stage rose, else null.
BeforeMatchOut.title: BeforeMatchOut

Break.description: Which break a report is for.
Break.title: Break

ClubIn.description: Choose the team to support, by team id.
ClubIn.title: ClubIn

ClubOut.description: A club. The page keys its crest and colours by ``code``.
ClubOut.title: ClubOut

ConceptMapOut.description:
The whole curriculum, with the viewer's level on each concept asked about now.

``tiers`` names the tiers in order, from tier 0.
ConceptMapOut.title: ConceptMapOut

ConceptMoveOut.description: A concept asked about now: mastery, level word and band at kick-off and at the break.
ConceptMoveOut.title: ConceptMoveOut

DeliveredTime.description: When a question is asked: live, or deferred to a stoppage or break (``restart`` names it).
DeliveredTime.title: DeliveredTime

FactOut.description: A fact: its value, and the text to show for it (number only, as the engine formats it).
FactOut.title: FactOut

FeedbackOption.description: An option after answering: whether it was right or picked, and every fact about it.
FeedbackOption.title: FeedbackOption

FeedbackOut.description: What the viewer is told after answering, with the whole evidence behind it.
FeedbackOut.title: FeedbackOut

Fixture.description: The two clubs of a match, by name and three-letter code.
Fixture.title: Fixture

FullTimeOut.description:
The match just finished: the score, how many questions, and how each concept moved.

``your_result`` is the result for the viewer's team, if it played.
FullTimeOut.title: FullTimeOut

GoalOut.description: A goal, by match clock, side and scorer.
GoalOut.title: GoalOut

IntroducedIn.description: The concepts the viewer has now had a First look at, by key.
IntroducedIn.title: IntroducedIn

LevelRowOut.title: LevelRowOut

LevelUpOut.description: A concept whose band rose over the viewer's last match: before and after.
LevelUpOut.title: LevelUpOut

MapConceptOut.description:
A concept on the map. ``mastery``, ``level`` and ``band`` are null for one coming later.

``waits_for`` names the askable prerequisites the viewer hasn't unlocked yet: the concept
is locked while it isn't empty.
MapConceptOut.title: MapConceptOut

MarkerOut.description: A player on the picture, with the team on the ball attacking left to right.
MarkerOut.title: MarkerOut

MatchOut.description:
One of the viewer's matches, for the Matches screen.

``score`` and ``your_result`` are null until the viewer has seen some of the match:
an upcoming match tells only its clubs and date.
MatchOut.title: MatchOut

MomentTime.description: A point in the match: period, seconds into it, the match clock and the phase of play.
MomentTime.title: MomentTime

Movement.description: How one concept's mastery moved: before and after, from 0 to 1.
Movement.title: Movement

OptionOut.description: An answer option as a question shows it. ``target_at`` is where a pass would go.
OptionOut.title: OptionOut

PictureOut.description:
The players and the ball at the moment, and the play's path when the form shows it.

``mark`` is a spot the question is about, such as where the ball went out for a throw-in.
PictureOut.title: PictureOut

PlayByPlayOut.description:
Who had the ball between the viewer's last question and the next, for the page to play.

Times are seconds on the match clock: ``start`` where the viewer left off (0 at kick-off),
``end`` when the next question is asked. The spells stop at ``names_until``, the moment the
question is about, so they say nothing of how that play turned out; a question saved for a
stoppage has play between it and ``end`` that goes unnamed.
PlayByPlayOut.title: PlayByPlayOut

PlayerNumbersOut.description: A player's numbers from the watched matches they started.
PlayerNumbersOut.title: PlayerNumbersOut

PositionOut.description: A position: its abbreviation, its name and what the player there does.
PositionOut.title: PositionOut

QuestionOut.description:
The next question, built from its question view only.

``score`` is the score as the question comes. ``catch_up`` says what happened since the
viewer's last answer in this match, such as "Truro Otters scored at 41:02.", then the
score; null for the match's first question.
QuestionOut.title: QuestionOut

ReportOut.description:
The scouting report for one of the viewer's matches at halftime or full time.

It covers the match up to that break only. ``right`` counts the answers that were right.
ReportOut.title: ReportOut

ScoreOut.description: Goals for each side, at ``clock`` for a match in progress (null at full time).
ScoreOut.title: ScoreOut

SheetPlayerOut.description:
A starter on the team sheet.

``at_kickoff`` is where they stood at kick-off, with the sheet's first team attacking left
to right. ``numbers`` is null before stage 3, or if the viewer hasn't
seen them play.
SheetPlayerOut.title: SheetPlayerOut

SheetTeamOut.description:
One side: goalkeeper, defenders, midfielders, forwards, each line left to right.

``formation`` is null before stage 2; ``matches_watched`` is null before stage 3.
SheetTeamOut.title: SheetTeamOut

SpellOut.description: One side's spell on the ball, as the play-by-play covers it.
SpellOut.title: SpellOut

StartIn.description:
Start watching, or carry on. Without a seed, the viewer's name chooses their matches.

A ``club`` (team id) makes the viewer's matches that club's fixtures, if they haven't
started watching.
StartIn.title: StartIn

StatusOut.description:
Where a viewer stands: which match is next, and their mastery of each concept.

``club`` is the team they support. They can choose or change it while
``can_choose_club``; ``suggested_club`` is the one "Pick one for me" starts from.
``pace`` is how often questions come; ``pace_next`` is a change waiting for the next match.
StatusOut.title: StatusOut

StrandValueOut.description: A strand on the radar. ``kickoff`` and ``now`` are null when nothing in it is asked yet.
StrandValueOut.title: StrandValueOut

TeamSheetOut.description:
Who's playing in the viewer's next match: their team first, or the home team.

``next_stage`` says what opens more of the sheet; null at the last stage.
TeamSheetOut.title: TeamSheetOut

ThresholdsOut.description: When a concept unlocks the ones that need it, and when it counts as mastered.
ThresholdsOut.title: ThresholdsOut

TouchOut.description: A player on the ball, at ``at`` seconds on the match clock.
TouchOut.title: TouchOut

get.description: The league's clubs, in team id order.
Every concept by strand and tier, with no viewer's values: what the questions cover.

post.description: Start watching, or carry on where the viewer stopped.
Answer the waiting question and hear the feedback.

put.description: Choose the team to support, before answering anything.

get.description: Every concept by strand and tier, and the viewer's level on those asked about now.

post.description: Record that the viewer has had a First look at these concepts.
